newsitem.title: USA: Frankel & Co considering initial public offering.
newsitem.headline: Frankel & Co considering initial public offering.

text.p: Marketing agency Frankel & Co said Thursday the company is considering launching an initial public offering.

"After examining all of the options available to us, at this point we believe that an IPO may be the most attractive option for Frankel to finance growth, while at the same time retaining our culture and controlling our destiny," said Bud Frankel, chairman, chief executive and founder of Frankel.
The company said it reported $28 million in revenues in the first half of fiscal 1996, and $47.5 million for the fiscal year ended January 31, 1996. It has 625 employees.
Frankel said the agency has doubled in size since 1993 and continues to grow.
